# Crystal Jaipuria

> Leading manufacturer, wholesaler, and exporter of authentic gemstone god statues, hand-carved crystal idols, Shivlings, Shree Yantra, Vastu decor, and spiritual healing products in Jaipur, India since 1989.

## Overview
Crystal Jaipuria is a trusted Jaipur-based gemstone and crystal carving manufacturer with over 35 years of heritage in artisan craftsmanship, wholesale supply, and international export. Every idol and artifact is hand-carved by master artisans using 100% natural, certified gemstones and crystals.

## Key Product Categories
- [God Statues](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/god-statues): Hand-carved God Statues in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
- [Shivling](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/shivling): Hand-carved Shivling in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
- [Shree Yantra](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/shree-yantra): Hand-carved Shree Yantra in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
- [Angel](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/angel): Hand-carved Angel in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
- [Crystal Statues](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/crystal-statues): Hand-carved Crystal Statues in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
- [Diya](https://www.crystaljaipuria.com/diya): Hand-carved Diya in natural gemstones and authentic crystals.
